short: Francis Drake was an English sea captain and privateer who carried out the second circumnavigation of the world.
full:
As a highly successful privateer authorized by Queen Elizabeth I, Francis Drake plagued Spanish shipping and settlements in the Americas. Between 1577 and 1580, he led an expedition that famously passed through the Strait of Magellan and raided the Pacific coast of South America. His ship, the *Golden Hind*, returned to England laden with vast amounts of captured Spanish treasure, completing the second circumnavigation of the globe.

Knighted by Elizabeth upon his return, Drake became a hero to the English and a hated pirate to the Spanish, who called him "El Draque." He later served as vice-admiral of the English fleet during the successful defence against the Spanish Armada in 1588. He died of dysentery in 1596 off the coast of Panama during a final, unsuccessful campaign against Spanish America.
